committee: * PRESENTATION for Resolution 167-38 (COR) -Senator Vincent A.V. Borja
title: Håfa Adai! Please be advised that on Sunday, May 24, 2026 , at 6:00 P.M ., at the Nikko Hotel, Senator Vincent A.V. Borja will present Resolution 167-38 (COR) in Recognition of the Knights of Columbus Guam State Council 99092 for its dedicated service through charity, unity, fraternity, and patriotism to Guam’s parishes and communities; and congratulating the organization on the celebration of its Twenty-Fifth (25th) Anniversary. We look forward to your attend ance and participation.
